prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-photorealistic countryside UGC fashion portrait of an approved adult woman walking peacefully on a rural road.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with fair skin and wavy shoulder-length brunette hair, wearing a vibrant magenta off-the-shoulder mini dress with a layered ruffle neckline, lightweight cotton-blend fabric, and white platform slide sandals with ruffled straps. She holds a thin sprig of wild grass and has a serene gentle smile while looking thoughtfully away from camera.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical full-body shot, subject walking gracefully forward on a weathered asphalt country road, centered with a natural countryside perspective. Dense green bushes and tall wild grass border the road, with a distant soft treeline and airy sky; preserve the visible dress silhouette, sandals, sprig, and natural walking pose.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Golden-hour sunlight from a 45-degree side angle, warm ambient glow, soft-edged shadows, and cinematic rim lighting on the hair. Keep the mood youthful in energy but clearly adult, airy, peaceful, and summery.
prompt.technical_specs: Sony A7R IV, 35mm f/1.4 prime lens, f/2.2, ISO 100, natural depth of field, sharp subject and visible fabric weave with soft background bokeh, hyper-realistic skin texture and subtle photographic grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-photorealistic 8K full-body lifestyle fashion photograph of an approved adult woman with fair skin and wavy shoulder-length brunette hair, wearing a vibrant magenta off-the-shoulder mini dress with a layered ruffle flounce neckline and lightweight cotton-blend fabric, plus white platform slide sandals with ruffled decorative straps and a minimalist silver necklace. She has a serene gentle smile and looks thoughtfully away from the camera while walking gracefully forward on a weathered asphalt country road, holding a thin sprig of wild grass. Dense green bushes and tall wild grass border the road, with a clear blue sky, soft cirrus clouds, and a distant blurred treeline. Use golden-hour sunlight from a 45-degree side angle, warm ambient glow, soft-edged shadows, and cinematic rim lighting on the hair. Photograph with a Sony A7R IV, 35mm f/1.4 prime lens, f/2.2 aperture, ISO 100, sharp focus on the subject, natural depth of field, realistic skin texture, visible fabric weave, and soft background bokeh. Preserve the airy, peaceful, summery countryside mood.
